blender.purpose: Create, inspect, and render Blender scenes for 3D storyboard work.

freepik-fastmcp.purpose: Search Freepik assets and generate images or video assets for storyboard and content workflows.

higgsfield.purpose: Generate images (up to 4K) and video (up to 15s) via Soul, Kling, Seedance, Veo, and Cinema Studio models; character training, video analysis/clipping, virality scoring, and background removal. Authenticates via OAuth to your Higgsfield account — no API key.

magnific.purpose: Upscale and edit images, generate image/video/audio/3D assets, and browse Magnific creations. Authenticates via OAuth to your Magnific account and uses its credit balance.
